# Picky Pens

> > A comprehensive resource for painting guides, troubleshooting, and techniques across spray paint, acrylic, enamel, oil, and specialty finishes.

Picky Pens provides detailed how-to guides and tutorials for painters at all levels, covering paint application, surface preparation, paint removal, and troubleshooting common issues. The site specializes in practical solutions for spray paint problems, car paint care, oil painting mediums, and DIY painting projects.

## Key Topics

- Spray Paint
- Acrylic Paint
- Enamel Paint
- Oil Paints
- Paint Removal
- Surface Preparation
- Paint Application
- Painting Techniques
- Car Paint Care
- DIY Painting
- Linseed Oil
- Troubleshooting
- Paint Types
- Chrome Finishing
- How-to Guides

## Spray Paint Guides

- [Why Is My Spray Paint Bubbling?](https://pickypens.com/why-is-my-spray-paint-bubbling): Guide to troubleshooting spray paint bubbling issues and prevention
- [Why Does Spray Paint Wrinkle So Much!](https://pickypens.com/why-does-spray-paint-wrinkle-so-much): Guide explaining spray paint wrinkling causes and prevention techniques
- [Is Spray Paint Flammable?](https://pickypens.com/is-spray-paint-flammable): Safety guide on spray paint flammability, propellants, and storage

## Paint Removal & Surface Care

- [How To Remove House Paint From A Car Quickly!](https://pickypens.com/how-to-remove-house-paint-from-a-car-quickly): How-to guide for removing house paint from car using acetone and solvents
- [How To Get Rid Of Gas On Car Paint!](https://pickypens.com/how-to-get-rid-of-gas-on-car-paint): Tutorial on removing gasoline damage from car paint
- [Can You Remove Paint From Chrome?](https://pickypens.com/can-you-remove-paint-from-chrome): Guide on paint removal techniques for chrome surfaces

## Paint Types & Compatibility

- [Can You Paint Enamel Over Acrylic?](https://pickypens.com/can-you-paint-enamel-over-acrylic): Guide on paint compatibility between enamel and acrylic paints
- [The Best Linseed Oil Alternatives On The Market!](https://pickypens.com/the-best-linseed-oil-alternatives-on-the-market): Guide comparing linseed oil alternatives for oil painting mediums

## Specialty Finishing Techniques

- [Should You Be Blackening Steel With Vinegar?](https://pickypens.com/should-you-be-blackening-steel-with-vinegar): Tutorial on steel blackening techniques using vinegar and beeswax
